al|holy-roman-empire: The Holy Roman Empire and Albania both show a black double-headed eagle. The Holy Roman Empire's eagle is on gold and has haloes; Albania's is on red.
am|artsakh: Artsakh and Armenia both have horizontal stripes of red, blue and orange. Armenia's flag is plain; Artsakh's has a white stepped arrow cut into the fly, pointing toward the hoist.
arab-revolt|jo: The Arab Revolt flag and Jordan both have black, green and white stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. Jordan runs black, white, green and has a white star in the triangle; the Arab Revolt runs black, green, white with no star.
arab-revolt|ps: The Arab Revolt flag and Palestine both have black, green and white stripes with a red triangle at the hoist. The Arab Revolt runs black, green, white; Palestine runs black, white, green.
arab-revolt|sd: The Arab Revolt flag and Sudan both use black, green, white and red. Sudan has red on top, then white and black, with a green triangle; the Arab Revolt has black, green and white with a red triangle.
at|austria-hungary: Austria-Hungary's ensign and Austria both show red-white-red stripes. Austria's flag is plain all the way across; Austria-Hungary's fly half turns into Hungary's red, white and green, with two crowned shields on the white.
austria-hungary|hu: Austria-Hungary's ensign and Hungary both show red, white and green stripes. Hungary's flag is plain all the way across; Austria-Hungary uses those colors only in the fly half, beside Austria's red-white-red and two crowned shields.
az|ottoman-empire: The Ottoman Empire and Azerbaijan both show a white crescent and star on red. The Ottoman flag is all red; Azerbaijan's red is only the middle of blue, red and green stripes, and its star has eight points.
beiyang-china|manchukuo: The early Republic of China and Manchukuo both use red, blue, white and black stripes. The Republic of China has five full-width stripes including yellow; Manchukuo is a yellow flag with four thin stripes only in the upper hoist corner.
biafra|mw: Biafra and Malawi both use red, black and green stripes with a rising sun. Biafra runs red, black, green with a yellow half sun on the black middle stripe; Malawi runs black, red, green with a red sun on the black top stripe.
bo|ethiopian-empire: The Ethiopian Empire and Bolivia both have horizontal stripes of red, yellow and green. Bolivia has red on top; the Ethiopian Empire has green on top and a crowned lion in the center.
british-raj|gb: The Star of India flag and the United Kingdom's flag are both the Union Jack. The Star of India flag adds a crowned golden sunburst with a star in the center; the UK flag is the Union Jack alone.
br|empire-of-brazil: The Empire of Brazil and Brazil both have a yellow rhombus on green. The Empire has a crowned coat of arms in the rhombus; Brazil has a blue starry globe with a white banner.
bt|qing-dynasty: Qing China and Bhutan both feature a dragon on yellow. Qing China's dragon is blue on an all-yellow field with a red pearl; Bhutan's is white and lies along a diagonal between yellow and orange.
central-america|hn: The Federal Republic of Central America and Honduras are both blue-white-blue. Honduras has five blue stars in an X on the white; the federation has a triangle emblem in a ring of text.
central-america|ni: The Federal Republic of Central America and Nicaragua are both blue-white-blue with a triangle emblem in a ring of text. Nicaragua's ring names Nicaragua and its blue is darker; the federation's ring reads "República Federal de Centro América".
central-america|sv: The Federal Republic of Central America and El Salvador are both blue-white-blue with a triangle of volcanoes. El Salvador's triangle is framed by flags and a laurel wreath, and its blue is darker; the federation's sits in a plain ring of text.
cn|ussr: The Soviet Union and China both have a red field with gold symbols in the upper hoist corner. The Soviet flag has a small hammer and sickle under a single outlined star; China has one large star and four smaller ones.
co|gran-colombia: Gran Colombia and Colombia are both yellow, blue and red horizontal stripes. Gran Colombia's stripes are equal with a wreathed emblem in the center; Colombia's yellow is double-height and the flag is plain.
czechoslovakia|ph: Czechoslovakia and the Philippines both have two horizontal bands with a triangle at the hoist. Czechoslovakia is white over red with a plain blue triangle; the Philippines is blue over red with a white triangle holding a sun and three stars.
democratic-kampuchea|kh: Democratic Kampuchea and Cambodia both show Angkor Wat. Democratic Kampuchea's is a yellow outline on plain red; Cambodia's is white on a red band between two blue bands.
democratic-kampuchea|vn: Democratic Kampuchea and Vietnam are both red with a yellow emblem in the center. Vietnam has a single five-pointed star; Democratic Kampuchea has the three-towered outline of Angkor Wat.
de|east-germany: East Germany and Germany both use black, red and gold horizontal stripes. East Germany has a hammer and compasses in a wreath in the center; Germany's flag is plain.
de|german-empire: Germany and the German Empire are both horizontal tricolors with black on top. The German Empire runs black, white, red; Germany today runs black, red, gold.
de|russian-empire: Germany and the Russian Empire both have three horizontal stripes with black on top and gold. Germany runs black, red, gold; the Russian Empire runs black, gold, white.
dutch-republic|nl: The Prince's Flag and the Netherlands are both three horizontal stripes over white and blue. The Prince's Flag has orange on top; the Netherlands has red.
dutch-republic|old-south-africa: The Prince's Flag and South Africa's 1928–1994 flag are both orange, white and blue. The Prince's Flag is plain; South Africa's has three small flags in the center of the white stripe.
ec|gran-colombia: Gran Colombia and Ecuador are both yellow, blue and red with a coat of arms in the center. Gran Colombia's three stripes are equal and its emblem is an oval in a laurel wreath; Ecuador's yellow is double-height and its arms have a condor on top.
eg|united-arab-republic: The United Arab Republic and Egypt both have red, white and black stripes with an emblem on the white. The UAR has two green stars; Egypt has a gold eagle.
empire-of-japan|jp: The Rising Sun Flag and Japan's national flag both show a red sun on white. The Rising Sun Flag has an off-center sun with sixteen red rays reaching the edges; Japan's national flag is a single plain red disc in the center.
es|francoist-spain: Francoist Spain and Spain both have red, a double-width yellow and red with a coat of arms. Francoist Spain's arms sit on a large black eagle with spread wings; Spain's smaller arms sit nearer the hoist with no eagle.
es|spanish-republic: The Second Spanish Republic and Spain both have red and yellow horizontal stripes with a coat of arms. The Republic has three equal stripes with purple at the bottom; Spain is red, wide yellow, red.
et|ethiopian-empire: The Ethiopian Empire and Ethiopia are both green, yellow and red horizontal stripes. The Empire has a crowned lion carrying a staff; Ethiopia today has a blue disc with a yellow star.
francoist-spain|spanish-republic: Francoist Spain and the Second Spanish Republic both have red and yellow stripes with a coat of arms. Francoist Spain is red, double-width yellow, red with a black eagle; the Republic has three equal stripes ending in purple.
german-empire|russian-empire: The German and Russian empires both used horizontal tricolors with black on top. Germany's went black, white, red; Russia's went black, gold, white.
german-empire|ye: The German Empire and Yemen both use plain horizontal stripes of black, white and red. The German Empire has black on top; Yemen is the other way up, with red on top.
gran-colombia|ve: Gran Colombia and Venezuela are both yellow, blue and red horizontal stripes of equal height. Gran Colombia has a wreathed oval emblem in the center; Venezuela has an arc of white stars on the blue and arms in the upper hoist.
holy-roman-empire|prussia: The Holy Roman Empire and Prussia both show a black eagle. The Holy Roman Empire's eagle has two haloed heads on gold; Prussia's has one crowned head on white, between thin black stripes at the top and bottom.
imperial-iran|ir: Imperial Iran and Iran today are both green-white-red horizontal stripes with a central emblem. Imperial Iran has a gold lion with a sword and a sun; the Islamic Republic has a red stylised emblem and white Kufic script along the stripe edges.
imperial-iran|tj: Imperial Iran and Tajikistan both have green, white and red stripes with a gold emblem in the center. Imperial Iran has green on top and a lion and sun; Tajikistan has red on top, a wider white stripe and a crown under seven stars.
iq|united-arab-republic: The United Arab Republic and Iraq both have red, white and black stripes with green on the white stripe. The UAR has two green stars; Iraq has green Arabic script.
it|kingdom-of-italy: The Kingdom of Italy and Italy are both vertical green, white and red. The Kingdom's flag has the Savoy shield, a white cross on red edged in blue, on the white stripe; Italy's flag is plain.
kingdom-of-egypt|mr: The Kingdom of Egypt and Mauritania are both green with a crescent and stars. Egypt's crescent and three stars are white; Mauritania's crescent and single star are yellow, with red stripes at the top and bottom.
kingdom-of-egypt|pk: The Kingdom of Egypt and Pakistan are both green with a white crescent and stars. Egypt's crescent holds three stars on an all-green field; Pakistan's holds one star and has a white stripe at the hoist.
kingdom-of-italy|mx: The Kingdom of Italy and Mexico are both vertical green, white and red with an emblem in the center. The Kingdom's emblem is a red shield with a white cross; Mexico's is an eagle on a cactus eating a snake.
ng|rhodesia: Rhodesia and Nigeria are both vertical green-white-green stripes. Rhodesia has a coat of arms in the center and darker green; Nigeria's flag is plain.
nl|old-south-africa: The old South African flag and the Netherlands both have three horizontal stripes with white in the middle and blue at the bottom. South Africa's top stripe is orange and it carries three small flags in the center; the Netherlands has red on top and no emblem.
ottoman-empire|tn: The Ottoman Empire and Tunisia both use a crescent and star on red. The Ottoman flag has a white crescent and star directly on the red; Tunisia has a red crescent and star inside a white disc.
ottoman-empire|tr: The Ottoman Empire and Turkey both show a white crescent and five-pointed star on red, and are essentially the same flag. Turkey fixed the exact sizes and positions by law in 1936, so differences are only in fine proportions.
sy|united-arab-republic: The United Arab Republic and Syria both have white and black stripes with stars on the white. The UAR has red on top with two green stars; Syria today has green on top with three red stars.
united-arab-republic|ye: The United Arab Republic and Yemen both have red, white and black horizontal stripes. The UAR has two green stars on the white stripe; Yemen's flag is plain.
upper-volta|ye: Upper Volta and Yemen both have plain black, white and red horizontal stripes. Upper Volta has black on top; Yemen has red on top.
ussr|vn: The Soviet Union and Vietnam are both red flags with a gold star. Vietnam has one large star in the center; the Soviet flag has a small outlined star above a hammer and sickle in the upper hoist corner.
